schema.time: Absolute seconds; duration0.1–600; shot times cover[0,duration] contiguously without overlaps/gaps. Playback advances only by supplied active game delta, capped at0.25s per update.
schema.coordinates: Metres in map coordinates after applying anchor position/unit quaternion. Source camera/actor keys are anchor-local. Uniform actor scale0.1–10 multiplies the existing prepared source scale.
schema.camera: Shots contain shotId,start,end,interpolation,from/to. Camera endpoints contain position[3],target[3],FOV radians0.1–2.8. Position and target must differ. Interpolation is step/linear/smooth (smoothstep); quaternion interpolation uses the shortest path.
schema.actors: actorId + canonical assetId/assetVersion, optional current contentHash, registered actorDefinitionId for skinned assets, optional known existing instanceId, position/quaternion/scale. Unknown or mismatched references reject before host preparation.
schema.transforms: One track per actor; strictly increasing absolute key times; complete position/quaternion/scale and explicit interpolation. Base actor transform applies before the first key, last key holds afterward.
schema.animations: actorId,start/end, actual configured clipId,clipStart/clipEnd,loop,blendIn/blendOut. Ranges are validated against actual glTF time-accessor durations in the lazy catalog, restricted to the registered actor's supported mapping. At most two simultaneous clip segments per actor; returned weights normalize when positive. Gaps request the prepared default idle rather than retaining an old pose.
schema.subtitles: start/end/text, bounded and data-only; rendered through textContent in the authoring interface.
schema.audio: time + existing audio.json sound ID + volume0–1. No arbitrary URL/music/model generation or embedded media.
schema.events: Allowlisted marker(time,type,label) only; no rewards, quest mutation, scripts, eval or arbitrary gameplay commands.
schema.validation: Strict unknown-field/version/reference/numeric/time/size checks return valid/errors[{path,message}]/document. Editor, AI import and game player share the same validator and evaluator.

api.references: {catalog,actorDefinitions,audioIds,instanceIds?}; catalog geometry.clipDurations is derived from existing glTF animation input-accessor min/max, without decoding model buffers or loading GPU assets.
api.lateCleanup: The lease restores once with restore:true. A preparation result that arrives after cancellation may issue release with restore:false solely for its exact late resource; it must not restore old map/camera/input/HUD again. Repeated pending cleanup joins the same release promise.
api.hostResponsibility: Existing world/scene/engine, tokened input/camera/HUD/audio/pause handoff, map-safe restoration, actor preparation/default idle/absolute native or Mourning procedural sampling and precise owned-resource cleanup are implemented in A/root's shared scene host, not a second engine in this page.

playbackSemantics.seek: Pure absolute evaluation and host sample; stops tracked audio; never emits audio or events. Seeking backward does not reissue cues already fired in the same playback cycle.
playbackSemantics.loop: Explicit user option; completion resets the cue cycle, samples0 and permits cues in the next intentional cycle.
playbackSemantics.pauseHidden: Paused/hidden updates do not advance time. The next active delta is capped; no wall-clock catch-up queue is generated.
playbackSemantics.termination: Completion, skip, cancel, replacement, error, death, map change, context loss and disposal converge on abort + audio stop + idempotent tokened release.
playbackSemantics.ownership: Player adds no render loop, native observer, engine, model parser or permanent timer. Root's existing frame loop supplies update; the dedicated studio owns one status interval and one message listener, both removed on destruction.
playbackSemantics.replay: Completion releases game ownership. A replay reloads the validated same document before playing; the studio handles this explicitly.

studio.preview: Dedicated HTML page contains one iframe pointing to the same game index with release=moonforest-0.1, appropriate existing map character and cinematicPreview=1. Parent creates no Engine. iframe src remains unset until explicit Load, so opening/searching the catalog does not preload all models.

studio.cameraCapture: Capturing an end key after editing a start key preserves the user-adjusted live preview camera instead of reloading the edited draft before capture.
studio.seekCoalescing: Concurrent slider updates retain the latest cursor while one seek/prepare is pending, avoiding a backlog of scene loads.
studio.ai: Copy a structured request containing allowed current IDs/schema/durations to the user's conversational AI. AI JSON import validates and previews shot/actor/duration differences before the user applies it. No provider call or automatic-generation success is claimed.
studio.storageStates: Browser temporary draft, JSON export, project-readiness validation, local registration and deployment are distinct labels. The page cannot directly write GitHub Pages/server files and contains no Git token/API secret.
studio.projectFlow: Same exported JSON goes to root's local validation/registration tool and game registry without format rewriting. A neutral no-actor development draft is available from createCinematicDraft; no bear sample or normal-play auto-trigger is created.

protocol.checks: Expected event.source object, exact origin, channel/version, bounded request ID, command allowlist and command-specific payload fields/types. Commands carry structured JSON only. Spoofed origins/sources and unknown command fields are ignored before routing.
protocol.bridgeReadiness: Commands queue until a source/origin-validated cinematicReply('host-ready',{ok:true,ready:true,mapId}) arrives. ready:false does not flush. An early ready signal survives iframe load; a late signal flushes each unsent command once. Each request has one deadline starting when queued; no non-idempotent load is retransmitted. send.reset(expectedMapId?) runs before iframe navigation, cancels old requests and rejects stale-map ready signals.
protocol.cleanup: Transport clears request timeout handles and rejects outstanding work on studio disposal; no per-play message listener is accumulated.

finalStudioHandshakeCoverage: Duplicate/spoofed/not-ready/stale-map signals never duplicate or prematurely post a load
Map reset rejects prior requests and gates the next map
Queued-command deadline expires once and never replays the timed-out load
Disposal removes listener/queued timers; asynchronous status callbacks skip a destroyed studio
independentReviewFixes: Dispose marks the player closed synchronously and queued loads recheck lifetime after previous cleanup, preventing concurrent/queued new acquisitions.
Load errors publish before cleanup; a rejecting release produces an explicit error and blocks acquiring an overlapping new lease.
Shot boundaries require exact continuity, including tiny1e-9offsets; defensive evaluation chooses the previous/first shot rather than jumping to the final shot.

limitations: No browser automation, screenshots/pixel comparison or physical-device GPU/FPS/thermal test was performed.

Real scene ownership, animation pose equivalence, resource plateau and project registration require A/root/verifier integration checks; mocked host checks alone do not certify them.
